mapper.select: SELECT o.* FROM pur_order o WHERE o.country_id=#{countryId} AND o.status IN ('CONFIRMED','PARTIAL_DELIVERED') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pur_order_line l WHERE l.country_id=o.country_id AND l.order_id=o.id AND l.base_qty>l.cancelled_qty+l.qualified_qty+l.pending_inspect_qty+l.opening_shipped_qty) ORDER BY o.id
